column1: # Template for the next allocation (scripts/campaign.sh replaces {R}). Plan (10-21 08:30, user): fix the cold/warm decode gap
# first. Bring-up directly with config/stage-b6-spf-pmtp.sh (prefills with the decode's EAGLE flags, operations/current_stage),
# then two C176 rounds with decode profiles: the first on a fresh decode must already match the warm level if the fix holds.
run start_profile_round.sh ROUND={R} VARIANT={R}-pmtp CONC=176 DELAY=900
run start_profile_round.sh ROUND={R} VARIANT={R}-pmtp2 CONC=176 DELAY=900
